source.timing_scope: Observed actual R4 execution

summary.occupancy_scope: Allocation time including recovery, not physical busy utilization

pressure.allocation_scope: Allocation capacity-time including recovery; not hardware busy utilization
pressure.queue_scope: Global ready-but-unscheduled queue; waiting jobs have no assigned GPU pool, never arbitrarily split by type. Means from exact time ledgers, peaks at decision samples.

timings.timing_scope: MIP printed setup/solve intervals rounded0.01ms; primary components use nonempty-plan rounds, all MIP calls separately. GPU stage includes preparation/MIP/smart. Allocator, R, identity+score and RAM have nested boundaries; do not sum.

pressure.aux_demand_scope: Decision-snapshot sum of each selected job frozen-table preferred legal-within-single-node quota / capacity; not original trace request, realized reservation, or proof of obtainable net gain. GPU-shape ceiling flag compares best legal response under current GPU shape with proportional response and global table maximum.
